caption: The drawing depicts a straight razor with its blade partially open, oriented horizontally on a plain, off-white background. The handle of the razor is elongated and has a mottled brown and black color pattern, giving it a wooden or tortoiseshell appearance. The blade itself is metallic gray with shading to indicate wear or age, and it is attached to the handle at a pivot point. The razor’s tang curves slightly with a dark outline, and the edge is visibly sharp. Below the straight razor, to the right, there is a hand-written signature that reads "Clarence Scott '38." The overall composition centers the razor, with no other objects present in the drawing.
title: Razor
